name: 1bb
description: 1BB Connect for Codex. Reads your 1BB goals, training, Voice DNA and shared sources, imports calls into your Gallery, saves drafts and proposes posts. Your AI never approves or publishes; you do that inside 1BB.

interface.shortDescription: Your 1BB goals, training and voice, in Codex
interface.longDescription: Connect your own 1BB account. Codex can read your business brief, goals, training, Voice DNA and the sources you chose to share, import calls into your Gallery, save drafts to your 1BB Library and propose posts. It cannot approve or publish anything. You review and approve every post inside 1BB.
defaultPrompt: Plan my day from my 1BB goals and training.
Write a LinkedIn post in my 1BB voice and save it as a draft.
Turn one of my 1BB sources into an Instagram carousel draft.
